personal.about: Graduate Research and Teaching Assistant at UBC, building computer vision and MLOps pipelines for automated lameness screening while supporting cloud computing coursework and capstone teams. Previously shipped fintech and banking products at Blue Rabbit Group and Oracle in Hong Kong—full-stack web apps, data pipelines, CI/CD, and AI-assisted automation across healthcare, trading, and enterprise banking workflows.
